name: smells_like_a_hoosiers_win
description:
Tired of white-knuckling your way through another Hoosiers game?  Then you need our “Smells Like a Hoosiers Win” candle - your new favorite pre-game ritual (or coping mechanism, no judgment).

Crafted from 100% natural soy wax and infused with a scent that says, “We might not always win, but we sure know how to show up,” this candle is your courtside companion through buzzer-beaters, bracket dreams, and the eternal hope that this is the season.

It’s warm, nostalgic, and as comforting as a candy-striped warm-up pant. Whether you're lighting it for good luck before tip-off or just trying to mask the scent of fourth-quarter stress sweat, this candle's got your back like Bobby Knight had that chair.

A must-have for any Indiana fan who believes - truly, deeply, and sometimes irrationally - that the Hoosiers are due.
Go Big Red!
